latest_release.name: OONI Probe CLI v3.31.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* chore: update version to v3.32.0-alpha by @DecFox in https://github.com/ooni/probe-cli/pull/1858
* feat: expose version and engine in oonimkall for callers by @DecFox in https://github.com/ooni/probe-cli/pull/1860
* chore: update user agent string to recent chrome version by @DecFox in https://github.com/ooni/probe-cli/pull/1861
* Brotli and utls dependency updates for probe-cli by @NewEraCracker in https://github.com/ooni/probe-cli/pull/1862


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ooni/probe-cli/compare/v3.31.0...v3.31.1

hot_issues.title: [webconnectivity]: Support user-agent strings in request headers to bypass scrapper security
[Bug]: database is locked while uploading measurement
Replace legacy measurement libs with new ones for experiments
[Feature] Allow apps to lookup geoip information with custom db path for resolvers
[engine-simplification] Simplify the input scheme for engine
